## Decision B answered · 2026-10-15

Maintainer, in the epic PM session on 2026-10-15, verbatim:

> A、B、C 三项全按设计稿裁定：权限进导航、More 退役；Advanced 扁平成七个标签；权限页改五个标签。记到专题卡上。

Decision B is the second clause: the seven flat tabs ship. The Target section's item 2 stands as written with the breakpoint at 1000 px (not infinity): flat at 1000 px and above, "Advanced ▾" with the objectui#11794 name rule below it. The full record, with the premise to re-check (the Advanced menu holds exactly the five entries named), is on the epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446. This card stays blocked on #12459 (objectstack-ai/objectui#12460, enqueued).
